entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Design: F# Hot Reload provider shared by dotnet-watch, Visual Studio, and VS Code #55464
  • Make dotnet-watch test execution conditional in PR validation #55462
  • Official CI arm64 jobs failing with CredentialProvider.Microsoft.dll plugin startup errors #55457
  • Backport Helix Monitor support to 10.0 #55456
  • Add optional Windows Explorer context menu for file-based apps #55451

Closed

  • Test flakiness for Microsoft.NET.Build.Tests.GivenThatWeWantToBuildAnAppWithLibrary.It_generates_satellite_assemblies #55408
  • Sign SDK archives and publish detached signatures as part official builds #51435
    11.0.1xx
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression][Alpline Linux] With .NET SDK 11.0.100-preview.7.26363.117, dotnet crash with HostFxrRuntimePropertyNotSetException on Alpine only #55264
  • Blazor WASM diagnostics feature switches never default on (BlazorWasmDiagnosticsEnabled vs BlazorWebAssemblyDiagnosticsEnabled property mismatch) #55446
  • NETSDK1083 error when providing multiple RIDs in .NET Core 3 #11426

PullRequests

Created

  • [Experiment] Agentic CI Investigation Workflow #55467
  • Fix zsh/fish completions emitting invalid Windows-style option switches #55466
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55465
  • Replace nuget.org feed URLs with packagefeedproxy in tests #55463
  • Fix 'dotnet publish -o .' excluding all source files (CS5001) #55461
  • Skip test-runtime install on cross-architecture builds #55460
  • Remove razor_tooling configuration #55459
    Servicing-consider, Branch Lockdown
  • Implement global command-line options for dotnet test (MTP): --timeout and --maximum-failed-tests #55458
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55455
  • [release/11.0.1xx-preview7] Expose --no-banner in MTP dotnet test help #55454
    backport
  • [release/11.0.1xx-preview7] Fix Blazor WebAssembly diagnostics defaults to use the defined opt-out property #55450
    backport
  • Fix repeatable attribute matching in ApiCompat #55448

Merged

  • [release/11.0.1xx-preview7] Add MTP artifact post-processing to dotnet test #55453
    Approved to merge, backport, 11.0-preview7
  • [release/11.0.1xx-preview7] Honor Configuration environment variable in CLI options #55452
    Approved to merge, backport, 11.0-preview7
  • Simplify MacAddressGetter to use NetworkInterface API directly #55420
  • Better error when workload set version uses package version format #54929
    Area-CLI, Area-Workloads
  • Honor Configuration environment variable in CLI options #55431
    Area-dotnet test, breaking-change, Area-CLI, cli-ux, needs-breaking-change-doc-created
  • Fix flaky It_generates_satellite_assemblies by decoding captured test stdout as UTF-8 #55428
  • Add copilot-app LLM environment telemetry detection [10.0.4xx] #55443
  • Preserve whitespace paths in static web asset tasks #55266
  • Enable live output for MSTest tests #55418
  • Migrate DefineStaticWebAssets to multithreaded task execution #55117
  • Fix Blazor WebAssembly diagnostics defaults to use the defined opt-out property #55447

Updated

  • Fix `applicable_kinds` for type parameters in EditorConfig template #52899
  • Enable MSBuild-backed commands in the Native AOT CLI #55441
  • Reclassify Microsoft.Win32.Msi.Manual.Tests as a standalone manual tool #55272
  • [Backport][10.0.1xx] Add suppressor support for `dotnet format` #51997
    Servicing-consider, 10.0.3
  • Add --allow-prerelease and --no-sdk-version options to dotnet new globaljson template #54133
  • Add `dotnetup` Version Intent & Timeline Doc #55390
  • Add F# hot reload support to dotnet-watch #55128
  • Convert dotnet-format integration tests from pipeline YAML to MSTest/Helix #55399
  • [automated] Merge branch 'main' => 'release/dnup' #55387
  • [Multithreaded] Migrate RunReadyToRunCompiler #55339
  • Migrate GenerateStaticWebAssetEndpointsManifest to IMultiThreadableTask #54706
  • Host the Razor source generator in rzc (opt-in generate/discover) #55422
  • Added fixer for CA1848: Use the LoggerMessage delegates #52622
    Area-Infrastructure
